name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant engineer for perpetual futures markets. Ask your own Senpi agent what's moving, run a signals sweep, read smart-money positioning, research traders, score any wallet with the Quant Desk, review your own portfolio and trades, and work through a strategy. Research and analysis first; trades and changes need your approval, in the conversation or in your Senpi app settings, and deposits and withdrawals stay in the Senpi app.

interface.longDescription: Senpi is your AI quant engineer for perpetual futures markets, research and analysis first. Ask your own Senpi agent what's moving, scan for market anomalies, read smart-money positioning, research any trader, score a trading book with the Quant Desk, review your own portfolio and trades, and get strategy recommendations, in natural language and backed by Senpi’s Hyperfeed market intelligence. Each of these is its own tool, and you can ask your agent anything else in plain language. Your agent acts only on your own Senpi account; trades and changes need your approval, in the conversation or in your Senpi app settings, and deposits and withdrawals happen in the Senpi app.
defaultPrompt: Scan the market for signals and anomalies
Run Quant Desk on my book
